title: Vehicle and Buyer Limits for Selling Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
# Vehicle and Buyer Limits — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans

Each tier of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans is sold only to its buyer type and only on vehicles within its limits. Vehicle age at sale is the sale year minus the model year.

| Plan | Buyer | Vehicle conditions the plan may be sold on | Greatest vehicle age at sale (years) | Greatest odometer at sale (miles) | Diesel-engine vehicles | Most plans active on one vehicle at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | Individual | new, certified pre-owned, used | 10 | 75000 | Not eligible | 1 |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | Individual | new, certified pre-owned, used | 10 | 75000 | Not eligible | 1 |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | Individual | new, certified pre-owned | 6 | 50000 | Not eligible | 1 |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | Individual | new, certified pre-owned | 4 | 36000 | Not eligible | 1 |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | Individual | new | 2 | 12000 | Not eligible | 1 |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | Fleet business | new, used | 8 | 100000 | Eligible | 1 |

## Points of reading

- Every limit is inclusive. A vehicle whose age at sale equals the greatest age, or whose odometer equals the greatest odometer, is within the limit; one year or one mile beyond is not.
- Hypothetical boundary pair on a tier with a 6-year limit: a model year five years older than the sale year is within the limit at age 5, and a model year seven years older is outside it at age 7. On a tier with a 50000-mile limit, an odometer of 50000 at sale is within it and 50001 is not. These model years and readings are invented for illustration.
- The Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit is the only tier sold to a fleet business and the only tier that accepts diesel-engine vehicles. It is also the only tier that does not accept certified pre-owned vehicles while accepting used ones.
